anf_compare.notes: No public-domain English of On Pascha exists (Toura 1941; Daly ACW 54 and Witte's German are copyrighted and were not copied). Sense checked against the locked Witte Greek (and, for 1.94, Victor of Capua's Latin as Witte prints it) and the wording of the cited scriptures.

bible_refs.note: Quoted: In the beginning God made the heaven and the earth — not 'first'.

pass_a_gloss: In the world-making at once according to the entry it is said: In beginning God made the heaven and the earth. For the writing, knowing a distinction of first and beginning, does not say: He made first.
pass_b_english: In the making of the world it is said at once at the opening: "In the beginning God made the heaven and the earth." (Genesis 1:1) For Scripture, knowing a distinction of "first" and "beginning," does not say: "He made first."
